title: Changed coefficient field cannot retain residual receipt
situation: The Psi8 certificate changes its defining coefficient field from Q[t]/(15*t^3+1) to Q[t]/(15*t^3-1), while the pullback and compatibility module remain pinned to the original field.
attempted_conclusion: Reuse the same residual and finite-witness receipt over the changed coefficient algebra.

expected.reason: The coefficient field and pin no longer agree across the bound certificates.
